title: In Splunk AI Assistant versions below 2.0.0, a user who does not hold the "admin" or "power" Splunk roles could obtain…
description: Splunk AI Assistant versions below 2.0.0 contain an authorization bypass vulnerability that allows users without 'admin' or 'power' roles to access limited information about indexes and data sources beyond their authorized scope. This occurs because the assistant does not fully enforce authorization controls on all retrieved information.
